STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_09811_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_09811_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_09811(
    input clk, 
    input rst, 
    input rx, 
    output tx, 
    input transmit, 
    input [7:0] tx_byte, 
    output received, 
    output [7:0] rx_byte, 
    output is_receiving, 
    output is_transmitting, 
    output recv_error 
);

    parameter CLOCK_DIVIDE = 217;
    
    parameter RX_IDLE = 0;
    parameter RX_CHECK_START = 1;
    parameter RX_READ_BITS = 2;
    parameter RX_CHECK_STOP = 3;
    parameter RX_DELAY_RESTART = 4;
    parameter RX_ERROR = 5;
    parameter RX_RECEIVED = 6;
    
    parameter TX_IDLE = 0;
    parameter TX_SENDING = 1;
    parameter TX_DELAY_RESTART = 2;

    reg [10:0] rx_clk_divider;
    reg [10:0] tx_clk_divider;

    reg [2:0] recv_state;
    reg [5:0] rx_countdown;
    reg [3:0] rx_bits_remaining;
    reg [7:0] rx_data;

    reg tx_out;
    reg [1:0] tx_state;
    reg [5:0] tx_countdown;
    reg [3:0] tx_bits_remaining;
    reg [7:0] tx_data;

    assign received = (recv_state == RX_RECEIVED);
    assign recv_error = (recv_state == RX_ERROR);
    assign is_receiving = (recv_state != RX_IDLE);
    assign rx_byte = rx_data;

    assign tx = tx_out;
    assign is_transmitting = (tx_state != TX_IDLE);

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            recv_state <= RX_IDLE;
            tx_state <= TX_IDLE;
            rx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
            tx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
            tx_out <= 1'b1;
        end else begin
            if (rx_clk_divider != 0) begin
                rx_clk_divider <= rx_clk_divider - 1;
            end else begin
                rx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
                if (rx_countdown != 0) begin
                    rx_countdown <= rx_countdown - 1;
                end
            end

            if (tx_clk_divider != 0) begin
                tx_clk_divider <= tx_clk_divider - 1;
            end else begin
                tx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
                if (tx_countdown != 0) begin
                    tx_countdown <= tx_countdown - 1;
                end
            end

            case (recv_state)
                RX_IDLE: begin
                    if (!rx) begin
                        rx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
                        rx_countdown <= 2;
                        recv_state <= RX_CHECK_START;
                    end
                end
                RX_CHECK_START: begin
                    if (rx_countdown == 0) begin
                        if (!rx) begin
                            rx_countdown <= 4;
                            rx_bits_remaining <= 8;
                            recv_state <= RX_READ_BITS;
                        end else begin
                            recv_state <= RX_ERROR;
                        end
                    end
                end
                RX_READ_BITS: begin
                    if (rx_countdown == 0) begin
                        rx_data <= {rx, rx_data[7:1]};
                        rx_countdown <= 4;
                        rx_bits_remaining <= rx_bits_remaining - 1;
                        recv_state <= (rx_bits_remaining != 0) ? RX_READ_BITS : RX_CHECK_STOP;
                    end
                end
                RX_CHECK_STOP: begin
                    if (rx_countdown == 0) begin
                        recv_state <= (rx) ? RX_RECEIVED : RX_ERROR;
                    end
                end
                RX_DELAY_RESTART: begin
                    recv_state <= (rx_countdown != 0) ? RX_DELAY_RESTART : RX_IDLE;
                end
                RX_ERROR: begin
                    rx_countdown <= 8;
                    recv_state <= RX_DELAY_RESTART;
                end
                RX_RECEIVED: begin
                    recv_state <= RX_IDLE;
                end
            endcase

            case (tx_state)
                TX_IDLE: begin
                    if (transmit) begin
                        tx_data <= tx_byte;
                        tx_clk_divider <= CLOCK_DIVIDE;
                        tx_countdown <= 4;
                        tx_out <= 1'b0;
                        tx_bits_remaining <= 8;
                        tx_state <= TX_SENDING;
                    end
                end
                TX_SENDING: begin
                    if (tx_countdown == 0) begin
                        if (tx_bits_remaining != 0) begin
                            tx_bits_remaining <= tx_bits_remaining - 1;
                            tx_out <= tx_data[0];
                            tx_data <= {1'b0, tx_data[7:1]};
                            tx_countdown <= 4;
                            tx_state <= TX_SENDING;
                        end else begin
                            tx_out <= 1'b1;
                            tx_countdown <= 8;
                            tx_state <= TX_DELAY_RESTART;
                        end
                    end
                end
                TX_DELAY_RESTART: begin
                    tx_state <= (tx_countdown != 0) ? TX_DELAY_RESTART : TX_IDLE;
                end
            endcase
        end
    end

endmodule
